column1: # Snyk Code High findings that have been looked at. Read by snyk-scan.sh.
# Columns, tab separated: SARIF fingerprints.identity, verdict (fixed, hardened or false-positive), reason.
# The reason names what the flagged line actually holds and why it cannot be exploited. Snyk Code reads no .snyk

# File:line in a reason is the line at the scan of 523329f23 (2026-11-02); the id is the stable key.
